caption: Design of the human assessment (D-55); the diagram shows the procedure only, not results. Stage 1 (calibration, due 2026-11-22): the PI labelled 99 candidate claims from the registered runs, blind to the gatekeeper's verdicts; a set rule fixed before any label existed, with two recorded amendments, selected 40 claims (20 unsupported, 20 supported by his label, from 39 papers). Nine raters (R1 to R9) rate the same 40 claims, each in their own order, without seeing reference labels, gatekeeper verdicts or source pools. A rater qualifies as a registered rater by catching at least 15 of the 20 unsupported claims and passing at least 18 of the 20 supported ones. After calibration the PI decides who goes on and whether to run Plan A (registered six: 250 audit claims, 50 ClinVar misses, 214 gap candidates) or Plan B (all twelve: 527, 146 and 269); these are planning figures, not measurements. Stage 2: (a) each audit claim is read by 3 raters in rotating, overlapping groups of three (84 groups with nine raters), with a registered pair and a tie-breaker named per claim and the pre-registered rule C (at most 4 of 250 unsupported) unchanged; (b) each ClinVar miss is triaged by 2 raters, with the PI settling differences; (c) each gap candidate is adjudicated by 2 raters, with a third where they differ on the decision or across the pathogenic / uncertain line. No submission record is prepared without panel approval and the PI's sign-off; nothing has been submitted.
description: Two-band flow diagram, 7 x 4.5 in (slightly taller than the planned 16:9 so all 8 pt text fits). Stage 1 band, left to right: Reference labels (99 candidates, PI, blind to gatekeeper) -> Fixed set rule (+2 recorded amendments -> 40 claims: 20 unsupported, 20 supported, from 39 papers) -> nine identical rater icons R1-R9 (same 40 claims, own order; no reference label, gatekeeper verdict or source pool shown) -> Floor diamond (>=15 of 20 unsupported caught AND >=18 of 20 supported passed). Connector wraps to Stage 2: PI decides (who goes on; Plan A or Plan B) -> Plan A (registered six: 250/50/214) and Plan B (all twelve: 527/146/269) -> three tracks: (a) Audit with a 9-node ring and three overlapping triangles (3 raters per claim, rotating overlapping groups of three, 84 groups with nine raters, equal loads, every pair shares claims, registered pair + tie-breaker per claim, rule C at most 4 of 250 unsupported); (b) Triage of ClinVar misses (2 raters per item; PI settles differences); (c) Gap adjudication (2 raters per candidate; a third where they differ on the decision or across the pathogenic / uncertain line) -> Sign-off (panel approval + PI sign-off before any submission record; nothing submitted yet). Okabe-Ito colours; no results, no rater identities, no capped kind or cap size.
